# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Write down the numbers of any items that failed the test.

## Instructions for the user
- **User name**: Thank you for sending me the test results. I have good news and…bad news😞
- **User name**: The good news is that your appliances have been checked for safety. The bad news is that some of them failed.
- **User name**: I will list all items which failed the checks in this message. I really encourage you to throw these items away and not attempt to use them. They are a potential fire hazard!

1. Show user the numbers and his model descriptions if available.
2. Ask if user would like to show him any particular item.
3. Don’t use the names of the items, but the numbers on the sticker + their model number.

## Model descriptions
